parties: EFC (I) Limited; Ultrafresh Modular Solutions Limited
headline: EFC (I) Limited acquires Ultrafresh Modular Solutions Limited
sum: EFC (I) Limited has announced the acquisition of Ultrafresh Modular Solutions Limited, as intimated to NSE under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) 2015.
implication: The Reg. 30 disclosure suggests a material acquisition by a listed entity; partners should verify the consideration, deal structure (asset/share sale), whether NCLT approval (if any) is required, and whether CCI merger threshold is breached.
detail: EFC (I) Limited, a listed company on NSE, has notified the stock exchange of its acquisition of Ultrafresh Modular Solutions Limited. The disclosure was filed as a Regulation 30 intimation, the standard mechanism for listed entities to announce material events. The acquisition structure, consideration amount, and timing to completion remain subject to verification from company press releases or detailed exchange filings.

framework.note: central — mandatory disclosure for material acquisitions by listed entities within 30 mins of board approval or prior intimation of availability to public.
central — acquisition may trigger CCI merger notification if combined asset value or turnover thresholds are exceeded (₹2,000 cr and ₹6,000 cr respectively, as of 2023).
central — if acquisition results in >50% ownership, disclosure and accounting treatment under Companies Act may apply.

framework.note: central — if structured as a scheme under Companies Act Section 230-232 or merger under IBC rules, NCLT approval may be required.
